title: knowing others experience this is freaking me out - my mall world tour

meta.occupation_in_dream: Doing homework (mentions used to be in college; subconscious hasn't realized graduated).
meta.author_theory: Compares to Backrooms; describes world as PS2/cardboard cutouts; suggests concept based on something like this.

locations.location_name: Childhood street in unfamiliar valley (cardboard cutout zone)

qualities.raw_description: "strange, deserted cardboard cutout of my old childhood street"; "heavily-compressed PS2 fakeout zone"; buildings go "elaborate and pristine" to "oddly geometric, without purpose, 2D 'cardboard cutouts' to totally empty"

locations.location_name: Empty food takeout joint (east road, left side)

position.relative_to: Left side of road when walking east from the T/intersection

qualities.raw_description: "empty food takeout joint"; "unfinished like a PS2 model"; "Dark brown wooden floors, grey countertops and walls, brick foundation, neon signs"; "large windows make everything bright"; sits and looks out large windows

locations.location_name: Shopping plaza with black-window rooms (east road, right side)

position.relative_to: Across from takeout joint on right side of road

qualities.raw_description: "shopping plaza with no signs"; "windows that lead to pitch black rooms"; "buildings are plain tan"; "parking lot pavement is weathered light grey"; dreamer: "I haven't been able to get over there yet" and "deep down I should never go there"

locations.location_name: Huge movie theater (also miniature theme ride)

position.relative_to: Continuing east on left side of road

qualities.raw_description: Ceiling "goes up incredibly far"; entryway expansive; "very dark" with concession lighting; glowing movie posters; white tile floor and plain white walls; stairs with black railing to carpeted area; hallways "slightly too narrow to look right"; showing room: red seats at incline, massive screen with ads washing room out in white; "completely 100% empty and silent"

locations.location_name: Theater ride tunnel/track loop

position.relative_to: Right hallway from theater carpeted area; ride area

qualities.raw_description: Green round cart on tracks; step off platform to sit; black tunnel with black lights; small-world setups for "various fakeout movies"; goes in big circle; popcorn "tastes stale and old"

locations.location_name: Main mall entrance embedded in cliff (tan arch)

position.relative_to: End of valley, embedded into a cliff; reached by continuing east past theater

qualities.raw_description: "giant tan arch with windows built into the top half and doors on the bottom half"; inside: lights off, faint blue skylight through glass domes; Topeka mall-like; L-shaped layout; white tile floor; grey carpet on second floor; cut-out balcony with white railings

locations.location_name: Cafe/gift shop combo (left immediately on entry)

position.relative_to: Immediately left after entering mall; requires a step down

qualities.raw_description: Red carpet; rows of tan-brown shelves; white walls; "You have to take a step down"; dreamer helped scrub carpets

locations.location_name: Mall main concourse (L-shaped, very high ceilings)

position.relative_to: Leaving cafe and turning left into main mall

qualities.raw_description: Ceilings "skyrocket upwards"; glass domes with "faint blue skylight"; "lights are off"; white tiles; second floor with grey carpet; escalators; empty and quiet

locations.location_name: Second floor landing (near blue metal door)

position.relative_to: Top of escalator from mall concourse

qualities.raw_description: Second floor described as "mysterious"; directly right of escalator step-off point is a blue metal door

locations.location_name: Yellow spiral staircase room (behind blue metal door)

position.relative_to: Behind blue metal door on second floor

qualities.raw_description: Narrow circular room like castle tower; yellow wallpaper; stairs made of same material; "looks like a PS2 model"; "very bright here from sunlight"

locations.location_name: Mall roof / exit-feeling viewpoint

position.relative_to: Top of spiral stairs

qualities.raw_description: "bright blue sky and white fluffy clouds"; feels like "leaving the mall world"; glimpse of large city with grey skyscrapers on horizon

locations.location_name: Large city with grey skyscrapers (glimpse)

position.relative_to: Seen beyond/after roof route

qualities.raw_description: "large city with grey skyscrapers out on the horizon"

locations.location_name: Punk trinket shop (Spencer's-like)

position.relative_to: At crook of L-shaped second floor; reached by continuing right from spiral staircase area along blank wall

qualities.raw_description: "expanse of blank wall" to crook; store is dark with black carpet and neon blue signs; step down to enter; lava lamps, rubix cubes, novelty office supplies; "specific store feels disturbing"; register woman feels like "real person being forced to say predetermined voice lines"; paranoia increases

locations.location_name: Grey liminal library (inside mall)

position.relative_to: From crook of L, most populated store area; wide rectangular entrance from mall corridor

qualities.raw_description: "entirely different world"; "endless grey metal shelves"; off-white walls; fluorescent lights; worn grey carpet; "dry book dust smell"; maze-like vast expanse; exits framed by "white square pillars" leading to other dream malls

locations.location_name: Other dream malls beyond library exits (bright, packed)

position.relative_to: Reached through pillar-framed exits within grey library maze

qualities.raw_description: "Huge, towering buildings"; "packed with very realistic people"; "bright and lively"; smell like "cheap Chinese food. Orange chicken"; dreamer avoids except one time got lost

locations.location_name: Ornate sunlit library (downstairs from grey library)

position.relative_to: Downstairs via escalator with glass panel railings inside grey library

qualities.raw_description: "astute, detailed, rather beautiful"; ornate wood; octagonal lobby with plush benches; brushed-gold crest on wall; thick leatherbound books with gold inlays; realistic people

locations.location_name: Upper floor of ornate library (blank/thin books)

position.relative_to: Upper floor within ornate library area

qualities.raw_description: "upper floor seems to be full of null, paperback, thin books that are blank"; children; adults in business casual uniforms talking; bookkeepers "fleeting... like a mirage"

locations.location_name: Bottom floor reading nook + kids play area (ornate library)

position.relative_to: Bottom floor within ornate library area

qualities.raw_description: "beautifully cozy reading nook"; kids play area with fake green grass carpet; "tree house" play set; enchanted forest mural; stars glow in a simulated night sky; reminded of PBS Kids "The Good Night Show" set

locations.location_name: Knick knack / Disney-sponsored gift shop vibe (outside library, left)

position.relative_to: After exiting grey library back into dark mall, located on left

qualities.raw_description: Tan wooden walls; "Disney sponsored gift shop" vibes; cheap fandom-themed goods; "yellowy dim lighting"; memory vague; visited with friends/family

locations.location_name: Toy shop (Babies R' Us-like) (outside library, right)

position.relative_to: After exiting grey library back into dark mall, located on right

qualities.raw_description: Pale white walls; "blueish fluorescent lighting"; meant for very young children; "Imagine a Babies R' Us"; memory vague; visited with friends/family

locations.location_name: Western road / empty hills landscape

position.relative_to: Walking west from mall down winding cliff hill; passes plaza/theater/restaurant

qualities.raw_description: "literally nothing out here"; "Windows XP background hills"

locations.location_name: Lonesome blue carpet store (end of western road, night)

position.relative_to: At very end of western road; scene suddenly turns to night time

qualities.raw_description: Single light bulb over abandoned checkout desk (center, against back wall); back wall has decorated carpet samples above desk; pitch black hallways left and right against back wall; blue carpet, blue walls, brown-grey desk; walls have hangers full of thick square carpet swatches; "very creepy"

locations.location_name: Own childhood home interior (grey fog, empty jpeg spaces)

position.relative_to: Only house accessible on childhood road section of the T

qualities.raw_description: "literally nothing but grey fog and completely empty, jpeg-esc spaces"; can walk layout but nothing there; "first part" available since little kid; stayed long time before gaining control to leave

locations.location_name: Disney World / Worlds of Fun / water park / cruise ship / boardwalk mashup vacation dream (adjacent area)

position.relative_to: Adjacent areas of mall world; mentioned as separate recurring visit

qualities.raw_description: "my own Disney World - Worlds of Fun - water park - cruise ship - boardwalk mashup vacation dream"; "fifth visit"

boundaries.description: Shopping plaza across from takeout joint: dreamer cannot get over there; windows lead to pitch black rooms; strong sense they should never go there.
Carpet store has two pitch black hallways left/right behind checkout; dreamer avoids going down them.
Dreamer reports no recollection of exploring bottom of mall; "It's too dark and my gut tells me there's just nothing down there."
Route up spiral staircase to roof feels like leaving mall world; leads toward a large city with grey skyscrapers on horizon.

interactions.description: Sat inside takeout joint and looked out large windows at rest of street trying to figure out what was going on.
Attempted/considered going to the shopping plaza across the road but has not been able to get over there; strong internal sense not to go.
interactions.transaction_blocker: Cannot access/enter plaza area; avoidance/gut feeling; described as 'haven't been able to get over there yet'.

interactions.description: Peeked into theater showing room; avoided entering because it was extremely dark despite screen washing room in white.
Got popcorn/snacks at concession; popcorn tasted stale and old.

entities_involved.description: Skinny ginger guy with short curly hair; 'pops in and out of being a PS2 model'; doesn't talk; comes off dorky.

interactions.description: Helped the cafe/gift shop worker scrub the carpets.

entities_involved.description: Latina woman who works there; very talkative but speech is overlapping/indecipherable ('twenty different things at once').

interactions.description: Interacted with/register presence of woman with an afro at trinket shop cash register; speech too muffled to make out; dreamer felt disturbed/paranoid.

entities_involved.description: PS2 NPC replica of woman with an afro running the cash register; friendly; muffled voice; feels like predetermined voice lines.

interactions.description: Entered one of the other dream malls beyond the library exits on one occasion and got incredibly lost; usually avoids entering these malls.
Came here once at night to do homework in the ornate library area.
Avoided going down the pitch black hallways inside the carpet store.

extraction.extraction_notes: Strong spatial layout given (T-intersection; east road sequence; west road endpoint; mall interior L-shape; second-floor features). Some areas described as vague/unfinished/cutout entrances; lower mall not explored; other-malls and vacation mashup noted but not spatially detailed.
